what: Beside the site name in the middle of the header, ”→ current section name” is attached — it reads data-section-title of the section crossing the baseline (80px) below the header. On first appearance the site name steps aside from center to the left (−50% → −100%) and fades, and the arrow unfolds from 0 → 2.25rem. When the section changes, the old name slides 1.1em to the right with its width folding, and the new name enters from 1.1em to the right with its width unfolding — all .38s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). Returning to an unnamed section (the hero) brings the site name back to center

options.from: Selector for the sections to watch, default [data-section-title] — that attribute’s value becomes the name
options.line: Baseline (px from top of screen), default 80 — header row height
options.[data-fx-part=prefix]: Front name + arrow group (first child is the front name)
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Blank spot for the current section name
